provider: Gcore (Luxembourg HQ) - GPU Cloud (Virtual GPU / Bare Metal GPU) and Everywhere Inference (serverless-style per-minute GPU endpoints)
region_dc: Five dedicated EU regions per Gcore sovereignty page: Luxembourg, Frankfurt, Paris, Amsterdam, Warsaw. GPU SKU availability per region is shown only in the console [uncertain]; Luxembourg is the most commonly cited GPU region [uncertain]. Pricing page also lists Luxembourg-2/-3, Paris-2, Darmstadt, Frankfurt-2, Amsterdam, London and non-EU sites.
sovereignty_class: EU HQ (Luxembourg), self-claimed 'no non-EU parent company', own network/underlay (210+ PoPs) - full-sovereignty profile, no CLOUD Act parent exposure claimed. Certifications: ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II (sovereignty page; getdeploying shows SOC 2 Type I, PCI DSS, GDPR - discrepancy [uncertain]). No SecNumCloud, BSI C5 or HDS found. Runs 'European Digital Sovereignty' program with portability/exit plan on request.
monthly_cost: Public list prices (excl. VAT, Gcore pricing/ai, read Oct 2026). Smallest sensible GPU for 7B Q4: 1xL40S 48GB on Everywhere Inference EUR 1.08/h -> 24/7 (730h) ~EUR 788/mo (5x over EUR 150 budget). 1xA100 80GB EUR 1.26/h -> ~EUR 920/mo. 1xH100 EUR 1.53/h inference or EUR 2.82/h Virtual GPU -> ~EUR 1117 / ~EUR 2059. 8-GPU bare metal L40S node ~EUR 10.16/h (EUR 1.27/GPU/h). POC-hours: 20h on 1xL40S = ~EUR 21.6; 100h = EUR 108; EUR 150 budget buys ~139h of 1xL40S per month. No cheaper GPU (L4/T4/A10) found on price page [uncertain - console may list more]. Virtual GPU L40S/A100 1-GPU price not published, only H100 [uncertain].
billing_granularity: Per-minute, pay-as-you-go; minimum balance EUR 4 to start. Everywhere Inference bills exact compute minutes with autoscaling (scale-to-zero claimed for inference deployments [uncertain]). Virtual GPU: pay only while powered on; shelving stops compute billing but volumes/IPs keep billing. Bare Metal GPUs bill until deleted even if idle.
setup_fee_and_lockin: No setup fee found; no commitment on public pay-as-you-go tiers. Reserved/committed pricing for clusters only via sales [uncertain]. Exit cost: egress free from GPU clusters per pricing/trackers; File Shares EUR 0.10/GB stored.
gen_tps_7b_q4: [uncertain] Not measured on Gcore. Bandwidth-derived for L40S (864 GB/s) with ~4.5 GB model: ceiling ~190 t/s, realistic llama.cpp ~100-130 t/s. A100 80GB (~2 TB/s) ~150-200 t/s realistic. vs M4 mini reference 24 t/s.
prefill_tps: [uncertain] Not measured on Gcore. Compute-derived estimate: L40S llama.cpp PP512 for 7B Q4 ~4000-7000 t/s (RTX 4090-class reference ~9k); A100 ~5000-8000 t/s. vs M4 mini reference 221 t/s (~20-30x faster).
ttft_at_4k: [uncertain] Estimated ~0.6-1.2 s on L40S (4k tokens at ~4000-7000 t/s prefill) plus network; cold start on Everywhere Inference scale-to-zero adds container/model load time (unmeasured).
concurrency_slots: [uncertain] 48 GB VRAM on L40S minus ~4.5 GB model leaves ~40 GB for KV. 7B-class GQA KV ~0.125 GB per 1k tok fp16 (Mistral-style 8 KV heads) [unverified for Bielik] -> 8 slots x 8k ctx ~8 GB; 16+ slots feasible. Compute-bound decode throughput limits useful -np to ~8-16.
ctx_ram_headroom: 1xL40S 48GB: model 4.5 GB leaves ~43 GB; Bielik-7B/Mistral architecture native ctx 32k (Bielik v2 ~32k [uncertain]), so full 32k x several slots fits easily. VM also bundles 16 vCPU / 232 GiB RAM (Everywhere Inference) - RAM not a limit.
availability_status: Self-service signup and order from the console (sign-up links on pricing page), so available now in principle; per-region GPU stock not published and prices only visible on pricing page/console [uncertain]. Everywhere Inference smallest SKU is 1xL40S; Virtual GPU public SKU is H100 only; L40S/A100 are available as 8-GPU bare metal on public price table.
egress_traffic: Free egress from VMs, bare metal and GPU clusters per Gcore/getdeploying/gpueconomy; Gcore docs also say Bare Metal outgoing traffic is billed separately with no per-GB price published [uncertain - conflicting]. Object storage egress billed.
electricity_metering: Not applicable (cloud, power bundled in hourly rate). For reference L40S TDP 350 W.
hosting_model: Two routes: (1) Self-host llama.cpp (llama-server) on Virtual GPU / bare-metal GPU VM - full control of GGUF, chat template and tool-call parser, but public Virtual GPU SKU is H100 EUR 2.82/h (~EUR 2059/mo); (2) Everywhere Inference: deploy custom container/model on dedicated GPU endpoint, billed per minute; custom llama.cpp container support likely but unverified [uncertain]. Gcore also offers managed catalog models (Everywhere Inference model catalog) - Bielik not known there [uncertain].
tool_calling_support: Self-host llama-server with --jinja gives OpenAI-compatible function-calling with server-side parser; template/parser fully under own control. Managed catalog endpoints (vLLM-based) support tool calls per model [uncertain].
spec_decode_support: Yes on self-host: llama.cpp supports draft models (-md / --model-draft) and plenty of VRAM headroom for a DFlash/draft model on 48-80 GB GPUs. Not available on managed endpoints.
sla_uptime: SLA exists in written commitments; Gcore cloud SLA typically 99.9% [uncertain - exact GPU Cloud / Everywhere Inference SLA not verified]. Status page: status.gcore.com. 24/7 support advertised.
llm_inference_tos: Product is explicitly marketed for AI training and inference; LLM inference allowed. Custom-container/self-host llama.cpp is within intended use. No restriction found.
price_stability: Mixed: gpueconomy.com reports Gcore 8xH100 bare metal node moved from EUR 18.16 to EUR 21.82 per hour on Oct 6, 2026 (+20%); Everywhere Inference and Virtual GPU rates unchanged since tracking began (Sep 27, 2026). Short tracking history, so 6-month stability unknown [uncertain].
model_lock_in: Low on self-host/custom container (own GGUF, no catalog dependency). Managed catalog models can change; Bielik not listed in Gcore catalog as far as found [uncertain]. Exit plan/portability documentation offered on request.
